n: <int> Number of sensors in the network.
m: <int> Number of communication links between sensors.
graph_type: <str> Structure of the graph connecting sensors.
edge_weight_rule: <str> Rule used to compute the power cost of each communication link from sensor positions.

vertices.lower_bound: <float> Minimum link weight among all links incident to this sensor.

c_obligatory_components: <int> Number of connected components in the obligatory subgraph formed by mutually nearest-neighbor sensor pairs.
